Package io.github.janglada.orkit.scheduling

Class ShiftConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.scheduling.ShiftConfig
public final class ShiftConfig extends Object
Fluent configurator for a shift, used inside the lambda passed to SchedulingBuilder.shift(String, java.util.function.Consumer).

A shift is placed either on one concrete date (on(LocalDate)) or on a weekly recurrence (every(DayOfWeek...), daily()). A recurring shift is expanded into one instance per matching date in the horizon; every instance shares the declared id and is told apart by its date.

    • needsAtLeast

      public ShiftConfig needsAtLeast(int min)
      Sets a hard minimum head-count below needs(int). Each missing employee between the minimum and the target is penalized with Goals.penalizeUnderstaffing(long) (or its default weight when that goal is not declared).

    • role

      public ShiftConfig role(String skill, int count)
      Requires count of the assigned employees to fill a role needing skill, for a skill mix such as one charge nurse among four nurses. Each employee fills at most one role; the remaining assignees fill none. The role counts must not exceed the shift's hard minimum head-count. The filled role is reported in ShiftAssignment.role().
